blockingIssues.problem: Rationale asserts that the roof is the confirmed source of the damp, but the source explicitly records the roof only as a possible source and states that no cause has been confirmed.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: "Damp patches were recorded in three classrooms. The inspector suggests checking the roof as one possible source; plumbing is another possibility. No cause is confirmed. The school has arranged inspections, not repairs."
blockingIssues.constraint: The source supports only presenting the roof as a possible source and that no cause has been confirmed; it does not support stating the roof is the confirmed source.
